_comment: Teacher/Student/Course data. The LLM has NEVER seen this file. It can only reach it through an MCP tool call. That is the entire point of the tools demo. The data has deliberate patterns in it -- one student declining, one improving, one erratic, one quietly failing -- so the interesting question is never 'what is the number' but 'what does the number mean', which is the part the LLM is actually for.
